summary: Tested new chat history sidebar feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/chat/history/{session_id} returns persisted messages. Frontend: History chip visible pre-chat, creating 2 chats populates localStorage (wedora_chat_sessions) with title=first user message + timestamp. Drawer lists both, clicking older item closes drawer and hydrates messages from backend, appending 'thanks' extends the same session (session count stays at 2). Delete removes item; page reload preserves localStorage and re-opening from backend works. Mobile 390x844: drawer width 335px (~86%), no horizontal overflow.

issues: upsertSession overwrites title with the latest user message on every send in an existing session. After resuming 'hello wedora' and sending 'thanks', the drawer entry retitles to 'thanks' — losing the original conversation label. Preferred UX: keep first user message as the persistent title (only set when title is empty).
Delete icon uses opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 — invisible on touch/mobile until hover. Consider always-visible on mobile or a subtle 30% opacity by default.

action_items: (Optional UX) In ChatInterface.upsertSession, only set title on first insert (preserve original first-message title on subsequent upserts).
(Optional) Make history-delete-* button visible on touch devices — opacity-0 hides it on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatInterface.jsx grew to 370 lines with several concerns (chat send, share, history) — consider extracting history drawer + hooks into a separate module for maintainability.

loadSessions is passed as lazy initializer to useState (good), but sessions are re-loaded imperatively on each drawer open and after upsert — a single source of truth (custom useSessions hook) would prevent drift.
openSession scrolls to #hero via document.querySelector — acceptable, but a ref would be more idiomatic in React.
No storage-quota / JSON.parse fallback beyond try/catch — fine given 30-item cap.
seed_data_creation: Created two test chat sessions via UI ('hello wedora' and 'budget for 100 guests'); one was deleted during the test. Remaining test data lives in Mongo chat_messages collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat history sidebar works as specified. Only UX polish items remain (title replacement, delete button visibility on mobile). All required data-testids exist: chat-history-btn, chat-history-drawer, history-item-{sid}, history-delete-{sid}, chat-new-btn, history-close-btn. Note: the hero messages testid is 'hero-chat-messages' (not 'hero-chat-messages-list').
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. UX note: title overwrite occurs because upsertSession always writes the current user message as title regardless of whether the session already has one.
